verdict: APPROVED for source closure of scans 300–305 only. I read all six original scans in full, including headers, rubrics and the small role labels, plus the enlarged s304 crop. I checked every candidate block for these scans in both Hebrew and English. The prayer text, pointing, absence of cantillation, read order, documentary rubrics and English translation all match the source. The two prior blockers, the missing role-label record and the unread s304 label, are resolved: all eight labels are recorded and the s304 one reads חזן. There are no new human questions. This approval does not cover the metadata for scans outside 300–305, and it does not authorize export or implementation.
